release_status: PROPOSED SIDE-CAR — NOT A NEW NORMATIVE SCL REVISION
authority: Core v3.2 clean preserved verbatim; source/genre records remain active through existing aliases/adapters; R1 and R2 supplements are candidate contracts.

method.definition: Physical action method, not an owned weapon or an additional turn
method.gates: Feasible limb contact, actual actor ability and available commitment
method.effect_boundary: Only the actor action already declared; no independent inventory, attack or damage

weapon.definition: Constructed implement with selectable physical modes
weapon.gates: Actual item, usable condition, grip/hands, reach/geometry, selected mode and actor capability
weapon.effect_boundary: Use a single selected action mode; a cut/thrust is not a second item or free action

armor.definition: Protective construction fitted to specific physical regions
armor.gates: Actual constructed component, wearability, coverage/gaps, material, fit and compatible protection model
armor.effect_boundary: Protection only where a supported material layer intercepts a relevant channel; no stacked full ratings

natural_delivery.gates: Actual organism, relevant organ and position, action commitment, physical effect plus any separate exposure carrier
natural_delivery.effect_boundary: No attack, restraint, venom or free action without actual delivery and named species trait

behavior.gates: Real organism/cohort, internal needs, sensory knowledge, goals, reachable targets and current condition
behavior.effect_boundary: Observed autonomous behavior follows capability; descriptor cannot spawn animals or grant competence

stock.definition: Fungible goods classification only within exact compatible lot specification
stock.gates: Specified lot, actual positive quantity and unit, accessible location, owner/custodian and eligibility
stock.effect_boundary: Conserved debit/credit/consumption, quarantine and quality updates; template cannot create stock

information_content.definition: Informational content, optionally embodied in separately recorded physical media
information_content.gates: Known provenance/version/time, actual observer/recipient/access, validation status; physical copy only if instantiated
information_content.effect_boundary: Knowledge transfer updates recipient information; physical copy uses an asset and does not clone authority

storage_system.gates: Specific container/zone, geometry/capacity, material compatibility, seal/access, actual intake and records
storage_system.effect_boundary: Stock in a store is recorded once at its actual position; capacity is not stored quantity

equipment.definition: Physical equipment configuration and its usable operating mode
equipment.gates: Existing configured asset, function-specific connection, operator/setup, accessible energy/inputs and condition
equipment.effect_boundary: Supported delivery consumes time/inputs and uses actual task; nominal equipment listing provides no service

service.definition: Useful recurring output allocated from physically capable providers
service.gates: Defined output unit and quality, provider bundle, demand endpoints, link access and constraints
service.effect_boundary: Accepted useful output only, bounded by shared throughput, reserved commitments, buffers and input stocks

site.definition: Location/site archetype with possible installed systems
site.gates: Actual site/location, layout/rights, access, installed assets, staff and measured conditions
site.effect_boundary: An archetype can host facilities; plausible contents are not instantiated or replenished

habitation.gates: Actual people/groups, location, housing, sanitary/thermal/water conditions, support and capacity
habitation.effect_boundary: No new residents, beds, safety or supplies from selecting a habitation category

institution.definition: Institutional role or office as an organizational template
institution.gates: Actual founding/authorization, personnel, mandate, access/resources, procedures and accountable records
institution.effect_boundary: Office name does not create statutory authority, trained staff, stock or functioning service

link.definition: Connecting channel or route between real endpoints
link.gates: Named endpoints, medium, supported path, mode compatibility, access/capacity, delay and maintenance
link.effect_boundary: Movement or transmission only over traversable working link; reservations are not receipts

flow.definition: Planned movement or capacity allocation across real links
flow.gates: Source/destination, type/quantity, rights, route, window, provider resources and acceptance
flow.effect_boundary: Do not count in-transit payload at destination; forecasts/reports do not transfer ownership or resources

program.gates: Authorized deliverable and owner, actual tasks, inputs, personnel, staged prerequisites and acceptance evidence
program.effect_boundary: Progress is not functioning capacity until commissioned/accepted; no duplicate costs

hazard.definition: Potential exposure/effect channel, not an automatically active event
hazard.gates: Actual source/intensity/location/path, exposed target, protection, onset/interval and matching consequence model
hazard.effect_boundary: Only causal supported exposures change condition; detection or category selection is not injury

crisis.definition: Multi-process scenario descriptor without autonomous spawn authority
crisis.gates: Specific initiating cause, geography, actors, timeline, mechanisms, observation and termination
crisis.effect_boundary: Effects apply through existing systems only; no automatic population removal or infinite crises

movement_activity.definition: Movement of existing people or cohorts
movement_activity.gates: Actual identified members/counts, source/destination, feasible movement, consent/authorization, means and support
movement_activity.effect_boundary: Transfer the same people between locations; no duplicate arrivals, deaths or free carrying capacity

contracts.runtime_gate: Resolve feasibility from actual state, qualify source and actor, allocate compatible capacity/resources once, execute the action or process, then record measured effect separately from reports.
contracts.interval_and_end: Use a source/selected-profile-defined activation or threshold event and relevant work/transport time. No universal autonomous ticking, reset at scale shift or re-trigger on read.
contracts.care_and_support: Condition, maintenance, restocking, repair, calibration and operator requirements remain actual asset/service/work responsibilities, not granted by lookup.

contracts.negative_acceptance_fixture: A behavior label without real creatures or means cannot create a hunting pack or repeated attacks. Family-specific non-effect: The Pack hunter template cannot summon new creatures or grant free actions.
